# L4ZY menu plan for the settings assistant. GENERATED by distrib/tools/menus_plan.py
# from data/menus.cfg and traduction.cfg at every release: do not edit by hand.
# "## page | title | route" starts a page; the route starts at the main menu (Escape).
# "== name" starts a section (its title in the page). Lines are numbered top to bottom.
# On one line, " | " = side by side, left to right; "[ a / b ]" = a column, top to bottom.
# {if ...} = only shown when the condition holds. "> page X" = the button opens page X.
# checkbox / choice (radio buttons, "label"=value, side by side unless "one under the other") / slider / field /
# flag / key / colours: the setting follows. "note:" = grey hint line, "status:" = coloured message.
# Not resolved: loops over a count known only in game are shown once ("repeated");
# labels computed in game show as <function>.

# --- settings pages (Options) ---

1. note: Classic: original lighting, any GPU. Ray tracing: RT lights, sun and sky.
2. choice hwrt: "Classic (no RT)"=0, "Ray tracing"=1
3. {if hwrtraison() != ""} status: <hwrtraison>
4. {if hwrtraison() != ""} note: It needs a graphics card with hardware ray tracing and an up-to-date driver.
5. {if "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1) and RT lighting running} status: Ray-traced lighting is running. Its settings: Ray tracing tab.
6. {if "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1) and not (RT lighting running)} status: Ray tracing chosen, but not running yet (no map, or it failed: see console).
7. {if not ("Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1))} note: Classic lighting settings: Classic tab.
== Anti-Aliasing {only if tab "General" open}
1. checkbox "FXAA in Native (softer)" lookfxaa | "MSAA (Classic only)" choice fsaa: "Off"=<fsaa>, "2x"=2, "4x"=4, "8x"=8
2. {if fsaa > 0 and not "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1) and hwrtngxmodeapplied() = 0} note: MSAA: smooth edges, sharp textures. A change restarts the graphics.
3. {if DLSS/FSR built in and hwrtngxmodeapplied() != 0} note: FXAA unused while DLAA, DLSS or FSR is on.
4. {if DLSS/FSR built in and hwrtngxmodeapplied() = 0} note: FXAA off (default) keeps Native sharp. Quality = more internal pixels.
5. {if DLSS/FSR built in} choice hwrtngxmode: "Native"=0, "DLAA"=1, "DLSS Quality"=2, "DLSS Balanced"=3, "DLSS Performance"=4
6. {if DLSS/FSR built in and FSR built in} choice hwrtngxmode: "FSR Native"=5, "FSR Quality"=6, "FSR Balanced"=7, "FSR Performance"=8
7. {if DLSS/FSR built in and FSR built in and hwrtdlssraison() != ""} status: <hwrtdlssraison>
8. {if DLSS/FSR built in and FSR built in and hwrtfsrraison() != ""} status: <hwrtfsrraison>
9. {if DLSS/FSR built in and FSR built in and hwrtngxmode >= 6 and hwrtfsrraison() = ""} note: FSR sharpening after upscaling (0 = off, 10 = like DLSS):
10. {if DLSS/FSR built in and FSR built in and hwrtngxmode >= 6 and hwrtfsrraison() = ""} slider hwrtfsrsharpness
11. {if DLSS/FSR built in and hwrtngxmode >= 1 and hwrtngxmode <= 4 and hwrtdlssraison() = "" or hwrtngxmode >= 2 and hwrtngxmode <= 4 or hwrtngxmode >= 6 and hwrtngxmode >= 1 and hwrtngxmode <= 4 and hwrtdlssraison() = ""} "DLAA/DLSS sharpening" choice hwrtdlsssharpness: "Off"=0, "10"=10, "20"=20, "40"=40 | {if DLSS/FSR built in and hwrtngxmode >= 1 and hwrtngxmode <= 4 and hwrtdlssraison() = "" or hwrtngxmode >= 2 and hwrtngxmode <= 4 or hwrtngxmode >= 6 and hwrtngxmode >= 2 and hwrtngxmode <= 4 or hwrtngxmode >= 6} checkbox "Sharper textures (may shimmer)" hwrtupscalemipbias

== Profile
1. {if tab "Performance" open and not (not "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1))} choice GFX_prof: "Ultra"=0, "High"=1, "Medium"=2, "Low"=3, "Custom"=4
2. {if tab "Performance" open and not (not "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1)) and <GFX_prof> = 0} note: Ultra: the full picture (default). Slow and pretty.
3. {if tab "Performance" open and not (not "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1)) and <GFX_prof> = 1} note: High: nearly the same picture, faster: CNN, solid leaves, still models.
4. {if tab "Performance" open and not (not "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1)) and <GFX_prof> = 2} note: Medium: + half-pixel sky, 3 lamps, adaptive rays, 1 soft shadow ray.
5. {if tab "Performance" open and not (not "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1)) and <GFX_prof> = 3} note: Low: + 2 lamps, 1 glow, softer far, no soft shadows. Darker, fastest.
6. {if tab "Performance" open and not (not "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1)) and <GFX_prof> = 4} note: Custom: your own mix. A profile sets both views below and soft shadows.

== Commands {only if tab "Commands" open}
1. note: /say always sends as typed
2. note: /tsay always uses I Send In
3. note: /trep replies in the last player's language
4. note: /to name hello : @name, follows Auto-Translate. Tab completes
5. note: /sayto name hello : @name, as typed
6. note: /tsayto name hello : @name, I Send In
7. note: /tsayr hello : careful translation, slower (a few s), sent only if it works
8. note: /tsayteamr hello : same, team chat
9. note: /trepto name hello : @name, that player's language
10. note: /tfix better : last chat line was wrong (exact or example, see Examples)
11. note: /tfixout better : last line you sent was wrong
12. note: /tretry or F9 : last chat, MOTD or [INFO] (not assists)
13. note: /tretry 12 : retranslate F10 line 12 (numbers on the left)
14. text "/tsayde hello"
15. note: Replace de with a language code
16. text "/tsaytde hello"
17. note: Same codes, team chat
18. text "/toteam /saytoteam /tsaytoteam /treptoteam"
19. note: Same as /to /sayto /tsayto /trepto, team chat
20. text "/trepteam same as /trep, team chat"

## updates | updates | Updates
== (top)
1. text "Installed: L4ZY <tupdateinstalled> channel: <tupdatechannel>" (computed)
2. {if not tupdateservice()} status: Update service not running. Start the game with L4ZY.exe.
3. text "<tupdatemsg>"
4. {if tupdateavail = 0} button "Check for updates" : tupdatecheck
5. {if tupdateavail = 1} button "<tupdatelabel>" : tupdateapply
6. {if tupdateavail = 1} note: Downloads in the background. The game restarts only when you say so.
7. {if tupdateavail = 1} button "Check again" : tupdatecheck
8. {if tupdateavail = 2} text "<tupdatelabel>"
9. {if tupdateavail = 2} note: You can keep playing. Nothing is replaced until the game restarts.
10. {if tupdateavail = 3} button "Restart now to install" : tupdaterestart
11. {if tupdateavail = 3 and connected to a server} note: You are in a game: restart when you are ready.
